title: Natural integral strict augmentation with its ordinary normalization
statement: For an abelian category A with inverse-sequence limits and fixed derived categories of A and strict towers in A, let I be a simultaneous left-derived prime-power reduction with its ordinary presentation. Let RZ be a functor from the derived category of strict towers to D(A) and etaZ a comparison from ordinary limit to RZ. There exists a natural transformation a:id_D(A)->I.T followed by RZ. For every complex P its component at Q(P), followed by RZ of I.epsilon(P), is exactly the explicit ordinary constant/limit-unit quotient augmentation followed by etaZ at the ordinary quotient tower. No counit is assumed invertible. The strict tower augmentation and the ordinary map are explicit constructions.

source.place: Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion, canonical completion map; localization universal property and universal left-derived counit

proof.text: The ordinary quotient projections form one strict tower map by their consecutive-transition equation. Their naturality in the input gives a natural transformation const -> I.ordinary.E; map it to cochain complexes.

Apply the existing generic augmented-derived-tower-unit theorem with Q as localization, exact constant towers as G and DG, the ordinary quotient tower as T, its supplied left-derived functor as LT, ordinary limit as F, and the given RZ and etaZ. The left-derived universal property is the required right Kan extension. The theorem supplies natural t and v and the normalization equation for their composite. This is precisely the displayed formula after unfolding the explicitly defined ordinary augmentation.

theorem exists_integralStrictAugmentation :
    ∃ a : 𝟭 (DerivedCategory A) ⟶ I.T ⋙ RZ,
      ∀ P : CochainComplex A ℤ,
        a.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ RZ.map (I.ε.app P) =
          integralStrictOrdinaryAugmentation ℓ RZ ηZ I.ordinary P
